customers_say: Customers find the door lock worth its price and appreciate its reliability, with one noting that fingerprint and face recognition work perfectly. The installation process is straightforward and quick, and the lock provides multiple unlocking features. Customers praise its security features, with one mentioning the anti-pry/tamper alarm, and they find it easy to use and convenient, with one highlighting its thoughtful design for everyday living.

reviews.author: sunil singh
reviews.title: Cheap quality, no installation service and support
reviews.body: Please don't buy it. Cheap quality chinese make though seller calms to be produced in India. Even after 1 month of buying, no installation done by the seller. They cancelled the installation on their own and not replying to requests.

reviews.author: Ranjeet Gupta
reviews.title: Good product
reviews.body: Good product. I can see all listed feature in product as described. Product looks good, easy to manage, handle. Security features available as described.

reviews.author: Omkeshwar Singh
reviews.title: Great Smart Lock with Excellent Customer Support
reviews.body: Highly satisfied with the prompt customer service and quick installation. The smart features—face unlock, RF card, keyless access, and app integration—work smoothly. Premium build quality and fantastic value for money.

reviews.body: I have purchased the lock 5 days back and functioning perfectly all right, so far no issue and am hoping it would function as expected without any issue. Also, customer support team supported a lot to set up the lock and understanding on the features. Some features are still under research and testing if those being enabled then this lock will be in full fledged functioning to it’s best. Thank you LAVNA and keep maintain good relationship with the customer in terms of emergency support.

reviews.author: Smiti Mahabir
reviews.title: Good product, good features
reviews.body: The product is worth buying & the installation was very efficient & timely . The technician Lucky who came to install was patient & knowledgeable . All in all we are happy with the purchase & the service .
